title: Business Sales Desk Terms: Purchase Order References, Dock Booking Notice and Pallet Charges
content:
Whether a purchase order number must be quoted on the order, the days of notice needed to book a dock slot, and the
charge for each pallet moved on a freight delivery are set, for an order under
Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment, by the fulfilment service the order was placed under. The terms below give each of them service by
service.

| Fulfilment service | Purchase order number must be quoted | Notice needed to book a dock slot, days | Charge for each pallet moved |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Store Pickup Hold | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | yes | 5 | 65.00 |

One of the six services carries figures in all three columns: Business Dock and Freight Delivery, on which a purchase
order number must be quoted, a dock slot needs 5 days of notice, and each pallet moved carries 65.00. On the other
five services no purchase order number must be quoted, the dock notice figure is 0 days and the pallet figure is
0.00.

## The pallet charge worked through (hypothetical pallet count)

The pallet charge attaches to each pallet moved. On Business Dock and Freight Delivery, at 65.00 for each pallet, two
pallets give 130.00 and four pallets give 260.00.
